description.value: Caffe Motivo is a downtown Kamloops café situated on Victoria Street in the city core, specializing in fresh-baked goods and coffee sourced from JJ Bean roasters. It also offers light lunches and breakfasts prepared in-house daily, making it a solid resupply stop for cyclists rolling through the Thompson Valley. Catering is available for groups with advance notice.
